mapper.select: /* SQL_ID: com.hanatour.air.ols.flightPriceSnapshot.ec.qc.FlightPriceSnapshotMapper.findFlightPriceSnapshotList */ SELECT TO_CHAR(A.SNAPSHOT_ID) AS SNAPSHOT_ID , A.RESERVATION_CODE , A.TRIP_TYPE , DECODE(A.IS_DIRECT_ONLY, 'Y', 1, 0) AS IS_DIRECT_ONLY , TO_CHAR(A.DEP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DEP_DATE , A.DEP_AIRPORT , A.DEP_AIRLINE_CODE , A.DEP_FLIGHT_NO , TO_CHAR(A.RETURN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RETURN_DATE , A.RETURN_AIRPORT , A.RETURN_AIRLINE_CODE , A.RETURN_FLIGHT_NO , A.PROMO_CARD_CODE , A.SEAT_CLASS , A.PASSENGER_TYPE , TO_CHAR(A.BASE_FARE, 'FM999999999990.00') AS BASE_FARE , TO_CHAR(A.TAX, 'FM999999999990.00') AS TAX , TO_CHAR(A.Q_CHARGE, 'FM999999999990.00') AS Q_CHARGE , TO_CHAR(A.FARE1, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE1 , A.FARE1_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE1_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE2, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE2 , A.FARE2_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE2_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE3, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE3 , A.FARE3_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE3_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE4, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE4 , A.FARE4_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE4_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE5, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE5 , A.FARE5_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE5_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE6, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE6 , A.FARE6_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE6_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE7, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE7 , A.FARE7_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE7_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE8, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE8 , A.FARE8_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE8_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE9, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE9 , A.FARE9_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE9_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE10, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE10 , A.FARE10_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE10_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE11, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE11 , A.FARE11_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE11_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE12, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE12 , A.FARE12_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE12_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE13, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE13 , A.FARE13_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE13_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE14, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE14 , A.FARE14_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE14_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE15, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE15 , A.FARE15_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE15_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE16, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE16 , A.FARE16_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE16_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE17, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE17 , A.FARE17_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE17_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE18, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE18 , A.FARE18_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE18_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE19, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE19 , A.FARE19_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE19_AGENCY_NAME , TO_CHAR(A.FARE20, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE20 , A.FARE20_AGENCY_CODE , A.FARE20_AGENCY_NAME , A.CURRENT_RANK , TO_CHAR(A.CAPTURED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+09:00' AS CAPTURED_AT , TO_CHAR(A.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+09:00' AS CREATED_AT FROM AIR01.FLIGHT_PRICE_SNAPSHOT A WHERE A.CAPTURED_AT >= TO_DATE(#{dateStart}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND A.CAPTURED_AT < TO_DATE(#{dateEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 ORDER BY A.CAPTURED_AT DESC, A.SNAPSHOT_ID DESC
